about.heading: About Zanzibaba Timber
about.who: Zanzibaba Timber has been the island's trusted timber supplier since 2010, providing high quality treated pine timber for homeowners, contractors, hotels, and government projects across Zanzibar.
about.stock: With extensive stock capacity at our Kwa Ndevu yard, we maintain large inventories of all standard timber sizes and treated poles — ready for immediate dispatch.
about.supply: We source premium pine directly from mainland Tanzania, ensuring consistent quality and competitive pricing for every project, from small renovations to large-scale developments.
about.coverage: From Paje to Nungwi, Stone Town to Kendwa — our delivery network covers every corner of Zanzibar with fast, reliable service.

yard.heading: Our Timber Yard & Stock
yard.stock1: Our Kwa Ndevu timber yard is one of the largest and best-stocked in Zanzibar, with a comprehensive inventory of treated pine timber and poles ready for immediate sale and delivery.
yard.stock2: Whether you need a few lengths for a home project or hundreds of pieces for a hotel development, we have the capacity to fulfil your order without delay.
yard.bullet1: Large stock of all standard timber sizes (1x6 through 2x6)
yard.bullet3: Bulk orders welcome — competitive wholesale pricing
yard.bullet4: Dedicated loading area for quick turnaround

delivery.heading: Delivery Across Zanzibar
delivery.p1: We offer fast, reliable timber delivery across the entire island of Zanzibar. Our fleet is equipped to handle orders of all sizes, from small residential loads to full truckloads for major projects.
delivery.p2: With cash on delivery available, you only pay when your timber arrives — giving you peace of mind and convenience.

logistics.heading: Logistics & Loading
logistics.p1: We take logistics seriously. Our experienced team handles every order with care — from selection and loading to secure transport and offloading at your site.
logistics.p2: We work with contractors, hotels, and project managers to coordinate delivery schedules that keep your project on track.
logistics.bullet3: Contractor supply with flexible delivery timing

residential.heading: Residential Construction
residential.p1: From new home builds to renovations and extensions, Zanzibaba Timber supplies the highest quality treated pine timber for residential projects across Zanzibar.
residential.p2: Homeowners and building contractors trust us for roofing timber, framing, decking, fencing, and structural applications — all cut to the sizes you need.

villa.heading: Villa Construction Projects
villa.p1: Zanzibar's luxury villa market demands the finest materials, and Zanzibaba Timber delivers. We supply treated pine timber for beachfront villas, private resorts, and high-end residential developments.
villa.p2: Our team understands the specific requirements of luxury construction and works closely with architects and builders to ensure the right timber for every application.
villa.bullet1: Premium timber for luxury villa construction

hotel.heading: Hotel & Resort Supply
hotel.p1: Zanzibaba Timber is the preferred timber supplier for hotels and resorts across Zanzibar. From Nungwi to Paje, Kendwa to Matemwe — we keep the hospitality industry building.
hotel.p2: We understand the scale and urgency of hotel projects and offer bulk pricing, scheduled deliveries, and dedicated account management for hospitality clients.

government.heading: Government & Commercial Projects
government.p1: We are proud to supply timber for government and commercial construction projects across Zanzibar. Schools, healthcare facilities, offices, and public buildings all rely on our materials.
government.p2: With the capacity to handle large-scale orders and the reliability to meet project deadlines, we are a trusted partner for institutional and commercial developments.

quality.heading: Quality Assurance
quality.p1: Every piece of timber that leaves our yard is inspected for quality. We take pride in supplying timber that meets the demands of Zanzibar's construction industry.
quality.p2: Our treatment process ensures durability against Zanzibar's tropical climate — protecting against termites, rot, and weather damage. We stand behind the quality of every delivery.

gallery.heading: Project Gallery
gallery.p1: Browse our project gallery to see real examples of Zanzibaba Timber in action. From luxury villas and hotels to residential homes and government buildings — our timber is building Zanzibar.
gallery.p2: Each project showcases the quality of our treated pine timber and the craftsmanship of Zanzibar's skilled builders and carpenters.
